mainEntity.name: My bathroom fixture is leaking — should I replace it now or wait until it fails completely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the best time to call is as soon as you know the fixture is damaged, leaking, outdated, or being replaced during a remodel. Waiting can turn a small upgrade into a bigger repair if a leak starts or hidden corrosion spreads.
acceptedAnswer.description: If it’s leaking, replace it sooner rather than later. Small leaks can turn into bigger water damage, and a failing fixture usually gets more expensive if you wait.
